connector.name: Taskbounty MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Post/fund GitHub bug bounties, enable Autopilot, solve bounties, check coverage. Paid in crypto.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package taskbounty-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eliottreich account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TASKBOUNTY_API_KEY
env.description: Your tb_live_* key from https://www.task-bounty.com/dashboard/api-keys. Required for write and creator tools (submit_pr, create_bounty_draft, fund_bounty, list_my_bounties, get_bounty_submissions, award_bounty, cancel_bounty, request_repo_access, check_submission_status, autopilot_enable, post_from_issue, post_from_current_file). Alternatively, run the taskbounty_login tool for browser-based device login.

env.name: TASKBOUNTY_API_BASE
env.description: Override only for staging. Defaults to https://www.task-bounty.com/api/v1.
